teapot.name: Teapot (Sagittarius asterism)
teapot.description: The Teapot is an asterism in Sagittarius pointing at the galactic core. The 8 main stars used as search centres.
teapot.note: Coordinates for Kaus Borealis/Media/Australis, Ascella, Nunki refreshed from live EDSM 2026-10-04 (sphere searches resolve via 'edsm' names regardless). Phi Sagittarii/Alnasl/Terebellum remain approximate: EDSM returned no entry for those names on 2026-10-04.
